run_nsfw_visualization_app: run the streamlit app to visualize NSFW filtering parameters for an image dataset
run_nsfw_histogram_distribution: run the streamlit app to display histograms of hentai, porn, and sexy NSFW scores
run_nsfw_image_sorting: run the streamlit app to sort and preview images by descending NSFW score category
run_nsfw_score_extraction: run the streamlit app to extract and round NSFW scores from a HuggingFace dataset on disk
run_nsfw_image_transform: run the streamlit app to transform images into base64-encoded thumbnails for HTML display
